author: Nerdstalgic
description:
At first, Curry Barker's Obsession looks like a familiar horror story.  A lonely young man makes a wish, gets exactly what he wants, and discovers that his dream has become a nightmare.

But Bear is much more complicated than a typical horror protagonist.

But how did Baron “Bear” Bailey become one of the most disturbing horror villains of the past decade.  How did Obsession slowly transform the familiar “nice guy” romantic fantasy into something genuinely terrifying.

#obession #currybarker #blumhouse #nerdstalgic
title: What Made Bear The Scariest Part of Obsession
